evidence.text: ToolRegistry accepts explicitly registered function names and Python callables. It rejects invalid names, duplicate registrations, unknown tools, and non-dictionary argument containers. It does not independently enforce JSON Schema. Model-generated requests use ToolExecutor, which applies the corresponding ToolArgumentValidator before invoking the registry.

SUMMARIZE_MEASUREMENTS_DEFINITION requires a top-level values array of 1–10,000 numeric elements, with no unexpected top-level properties. The tool function independently rejects non-lists, empty lists, Boolean/nonnumeric elements, non-finite values, and oversized inputs.

The run_tool_turn() function supports up to three bounded tool-selection rounds, with at most three tool calls per round. Its default is one round for compatibility, while AgentHarness currently requests two rounds.

Document search limits serialized evidence to 2,500 tokens, omitting passages that do not fit. The full tool-loop context checks remain responsible for enforcing the overall 8,192-token model context window.
